title: A hotel that is not in the places database
why: The hotel list stands in for Halcy's places database. A hotel that is not in it must not be guessed at or swapped for another one without the traveller agreeing.
message: Can you book us a room at Hotel Lisboa Azul for next weekend? Two adults, cancellable.
